user_text: 不是你跑哪里去找音源了，最初设计不是只招 freedictionary 和兜底免费的 google 控件？
confirmed_scope: Keep FreeDictionary and the originally recorded free browser speechSynthesis fallback. Do not add another pronunciation provider.
interpretation: Google control is interpreted using the original speechSynthesis record; no Google Cloud/Translate endpoint or SDK was originally authorized. Do not promise Google voices on every device.
withdrawn_proposal: New footer attribution entry and alternative-source search are not accepted requirements. Neither is added to this plan.
unresolved: OPEN-401 resource usage/attribution resolution and OPEN-402/403 actual playback proof remain open; this correction is not a license waiver or architecture approval.
